incident-bot: PAGED: p99 streaming tail > 2.5s (cont-batching path) across us-west-2 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: AlertID=INC-20260317-001, metric=streaming.p99_latency, threshold=2.5s, window=5m
sam (oncall): ack. paging in. looking at staging dashboards now.
lia: i'm seeing a sharp uptick in hetero batch sizes — a few very long seqs are fragmenting packer windows and holding slots. p95 also climbing.
kevin: that lines up with KV cache churn we saw earlier, long seqs + KV eviction = packing stalls. any affected models?
maria: model is rwd-open-stream-v2 (quantized). traffic surge from a customer profile with long completions.
sam (oncall): immediate mitigation: reduce max_batch_size for streaming workers to 8 and lower pack_window to 30ms. can someone roll a fast flag?
maria: on it. running quick flag:
```
./rctl set --service=streamer --env=prod 
  --set runtime.streaming.max_batch_size=8 
  --set runtime.streaming.pack_window_ms=30
  --desc "hotfix: reduce batching to avoid fragmentation stalls"
```
ops-bot: Flag apply started by maria at 2026-03-17T18:05:12Z
lia: re-routing a small % (~10%) of traffic to the low-latency model variant as fallback for affected routes. will monitor errors.
kevin: also enable preemptive-shed for hetero batches (threshold 0.85) so long sequences don't lock packers. patch ready, can deploy if hotflag doesn't cool it.
maria: flags applied, metrics showing p99 dropping from ~3.7s -> 1.9s in 1min. p95 improving too.
sam (oncall): good. customer impact check: lia, can you query customer-facing errors/latency by tenant?
lia: quick query: tenants with p99 > 2s in last 10m -> cust-alpha, cust-gamma. both on heavy long-completion workloads. no increase in 5xx though.
kevin: notify account teams for cust-alpha and cust-gamma. recommend they backoff parallel requests for next 30m. I'll prepare a fuller mitigation to fix packer fragmentation (pack_threshold tuning + fairshare scheduler change).
maria: ops-bot reports deployment of flag complete and no failed hosts.
ops-bot: deploy:apply streamer flags by maria — success (5/5 hosts).
sam (oncall): tl;dr: hotflags rolled (max_batch_size=8, pack_window=30ms), fallback routing enabled ~10%, preemptive-shed on staging plan. p99 dropped below SLO but we'll keep monitoring.
kevin: will open follow-up PR to adjust packer behavior: increase packer-lookahead to 64 tokens, pack_threshold 0.8 and add long-seq isolation lane. target rollout tomorrow AM with canary.
sam (oncall): handing off to kevin for overnight watch. please leave notes in incident board and tag pagerduty if p99>2.5s again.
kevin: taking over. adding runbook steps to incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
